status: documented connector-family fit study; exact installed suffix and pin-1 orientation unconfirmed
bar_pivot_basis: X-axis through the wire centre. The CAD crossbar centre is Y0.455,Z2.835. The drawing's 4.40 mm inner spacing plus 0.55 mm uncoated wire diameter gives 4.95 mm centre spacing, placing the pivot at Z-2.115. Internal latch deformation is not modeled.
bar_swing_scope: Enclosure clearance through both horizontal positions; follow the supplier's handling sequence on the actual part rather than forcing an assumed travel limit.
upper_swing_space_scope: An additional room allocation above the seated connector. The lower seating region is covered by the nominal part check, not by this box. This is not a full manufacturing-tolerance proof.
service_prerequisites: Release the display base jaw and free the loom before unplugging. Disconnect or release the fan/USB guides attached to the keyboard carrier before removing it. The complete keyboard removal sequence and dressed-cable handling still need a physical check.
access_note: Clearance corridors for narrow insulating tools. Their size and position do not define an approved pressing tool, force, or a safe contact point on an unconfirmed connector.
